title: hub-primary-battery
description: Payload for the shared primary battery setting: which battery instance every client treats as the headline battery (one bank can be published by two Drivers, e.g. driver-venus and driver-wattcycle). Published retained by the hub plugin to renewvan/hub/primary-battery (state), restored from the value it persisted on the Pi and published on every (re)connect, default "auto"; sent unretained by a client to renewvan/hub/primary-battery/set (command), which the plugin persists and republishes as state. The value is either "auto" (deterministic: sort instance ids, take the first complete battery) or a battery instance id (e.g. "512", "wattcycle"). The hub plugin does not know which instances exist, so it does not check the id against them: it only rejects payloads that are not a non-empty JSON string. A consumer whose id is not on the bus or not complete falls back to "auto".
